public function count_words(text: Text) returns List of WordCount
  purpose: Count every lower-cased word, most frequent first.
  example: count_words("a b a")
    is [WordCount(word: "a", occurrences: 2), WordCount(word: "b", occurrences: 1)]
  example: count_words("") is []

  let found: List of Text be
    for each line in text.to_lower().lines(), word in line.split(" ")
    where not word.is_empty()
    collect word
  let words be found.sorted()
  let groups be for each word in words group by word collect word
  return
    for each word, members in groups
    sorted by members.length() descending
    collect WordCount(word: word, occurrences: members.length())
end

public function count_words(text: Text) returns List of WordCount
  purpose: Count every lower-cased word, most frequent first.
  example: count_words("a b a")
    is [WordCount(word: "a", occurrences: 2), WordCount(word: "b", occurrences: 1)]
  example: count_words("") is []

  let lowered be text.to_lower()
  let words be
    for each line in lowered.lines(), word in line.split(" ")
    where not word.trim().is_empty()
    sorted by word
    collect word.trim()
  let groups be for each word in words group by word collect word
  let mutable counts: List of WordCount be []
  for each word, members in groups
    set counts to counts.append(WordCount(word: word, occurrences: members.length()))
  end
  return for each entry in counts sorted by entry.occurrences descending collect entry
end

```
public function count_words(text: Text) returns List of WordCount
  purpose: Count every lower-cased word, most frequent first.
  example: count_words("a b a")
    is [WordCount(word: "a", occurrences: 2), WordCount(word: "b", occurrences: 1)]
  example: count_words("") is []

  let spaced be text.to_lower().replace("\n", " ").replace("\t", " ")
  let words be
    for each piece in spaced.split(" ")
    where not piece.is_empty()
    collect piece
  let mutable counts: Map of Text to Integer be {}
  for each word in words
    let previous be counts.get(word) otherwise 0
    set counts to counts.set(key: word, value: previous + 1)
  end
  return
    for each word, occurrences in counts
    sorted by occurrences descending
    collect WordCount(word: word, occurrences: occurrences)
end
```
